LanguageData.DWRN.ToolInstructions:
Click this warning icon, then click a work column heading. All colonists assigned to that work will do it before other work, needs, or their timetable.

Click the same heading again to clear the order. A different heading replaces it. One forced work type per map.

Click the icon again, press Esc, or right-click to put away the tool. Putting away the tool does not clear an active order.
